title: Spreadsheets in Vibe Work
summary: Work with Excel and CSV files in Vibe Work, from analyzing uploaded data to creating a workbook from a prompt. Review and edit the results in Canvas, then download an .xlsx file.
whatsNew: Upload a workbook or describe a tracker or model to create. Ask Vibe Work to analyze, clean, or transform the data, then refine the result with follow-up prompts.
keyCapabilities: Analyze uploaded Excel and CSV data to summarize trends and identify inconsistencies.
Ask Vibe Work to fix broken formulas, convert numbers stored as text, and standardize dates and formatting.
Consolidate sheets, reshape tables, and join data from multiple files.
Create trackers and models from a prompt, then iterate in the conversation.
Review formulas and values in Canvas, edit cells, and download the workbook as an `.xlsx` file.

getStarted.label: Available on paid plans on Serverless. Start with the spreadsheets guide. Before sharing business-critical work, verify formulas, calculations, and formatting in Excel.
